t: This is The London Clinic, on the corner of Devonshire Place and Marylebone Road. It is a private hospital and a registered charity, and it is counted among the largest private hospitals in England. Its names read like a cast list. The actress Kay Kendall, who won a Golden Globe for Les Girls, died here. So did Jack Cohen, who founded Tesco, and the bandleaders Jack Hylton and Carroll Gibbons. Isabella Blow, the magazine editor who discovered Alexander McQueen, was born here, as was the author Emma Walton Hamilton, daughter of Julie Andrews.
